metadata.title: पंडो आदिवासियों की करमा पूजा और इतिहास । karamsanipuja Pando tribe । Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Pando is a primitive tribe in the state of Chhattisgarh. We met this tribe in a small village named Pando Nagar in Surajpur district of the state. There is an interesting story of this tribe's transition from nomadic life to a settled community in the year 1952.
